title: Little's Law: resident population
caption: Average in-flight requests equal arrival rate times mean time in system. At 1,000 QPS and 50 ms, the server must hold ~50 requests of buffers, threads and accelerator memory.

symbols.name: resident population
symbols.meaning: Average number of requests inside the system at once.

symbols.name: arrival rate
symbols.meaning: Requests per second arriving at the service.

symbols.name: time in system
symbols.meaning: Mean wall-clock time a request spends from arrival to completion, queue plus service.

title: M/M/1 time in system
caption: With Poisson arrivals and exponential service, average latency is service time divided by 1 − utilization: 2× at 50%, 10× at 90%, 20× at 95%. The knee prices headroom.

symbols.name: time in system
symbols.meaning: Mean wait plus service time per request.

symbols.name: service time
symbols.meaning: Mean time the server spends executing one request.

symbols.name: utilization
symbols.meaning: λ/μ — fraction of capacity the arrival rate consumes; the denominator vanishes as it nears 1.

title: Fan-out converts leaf tail into user tail
caption: When one user request fans out to n parallel leaves, the user waits on the slowest. A p99 leaf still hands ~39% of users a >p99 experience at n=50.

symbols.name: user tail probability
symbols.meaning: Chance a user request sees latency beyond the leaf p99 because at least one leaf is slow.

symbols.name: leaf tail probability
symbols.meaning: Probability a single leaf service exceeds its p99 latency (0.01).

symbols.name: fan-out width
symbols.meaning: Number of parallel leaf calls inside one user request.

title: Formation delay of a batch window
caption: Filling a batch of b requests takes roughly b/λ seconds at arrival rate λ — queueing time the published batch latency omits. At 10 QPS, batch-16 waits ~1.6 s before executing.

symbols.name: formation delay
symbols.meaning: Wait for enough requests to arrive to fill the batch.

symbols.name: batch size
symbols.meaning: Number of requests needed to fill the batch window.

symbols.name: arrival rate
symbols.meaning: Requests per second; low traffic inflates formation delay.

title: Batching divides the fixed charge
caption: Cost per request is the per-batch fixed work (weight streaming, launch, setup) divided by batch plus marginal per-item work. Fixed cost dominates at batch one; marginal work sets the floor.

symbols.name: cost per request
symbols.meaning: Time or energy each request effectively pays.

symbols.name: fixed per-batch cost
symbols.meaning: Work paid once per batch regardless of its size — weight reads, kernel launch, memory setup.

symbols.name: marginal cost
symbols.meaning: Per-item work that does not amortize — each request's own compute.

title: Decode floor: bandwidth per token
caption: Each generated token streams all weights once. GPT-2 XL's ~3 GB FP16 read takes ~0.9 ms on the reference H100 — token latency is set by memory bandwidth, not compute.

symbols.name: token latency
symbols.meaning: Minimum time per decode step (TPOT floor).

symbols.name: weight bytes
symbols.meaning: Model weight bytes read per token — ~3 GB for GPT-2 XL in FP16.

symbols.name: memory bandwidth
symbols.meaning: Accelerator DRAM bandwidth, ~3.35 TB/s on the reference H100.
